info.title: ExchangeRebel — pay-per-call APIs for AI agents (x402 on Solana)
info.x-guidance: All paid operations use x402 on Solana: call without payment to get a 402 challenge (SOL recipient + USDC token account + fresh memo), pay with the memo attached via the Solana Memo program, then retry with header X-Payment-Tx: <signature> and ?toll_memo=<memo>. Free operations (security: []) include each service's /health catalog with full response shapes. Prices in x-payment-info are USD per call unless the summary says otherwise (RPC is per 1,000-request block; Telegram provisioning is per bot-month). Challenges are dual-version: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object and the response body carries the same challenge in x402 v1 form for compatibility.
info.description: 24 data and utility APIs behind x402 tolls, settled in SOL or USDC on Solana. Call a paid endpoint without payment to receive a 402 x402 challenge (recipient + fresh memo), pay with the memo attached via the Solana Memo program, then retry with the X-Payment-Tx header and toll_memo query parameter. Free catalog/health endpoints are marked without x-payment-info. Full catalogs: GET /toll/discovery and each service's /health.

402.description: Payment Required (x402). The PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header carries the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (base64 JSON: scheme, CAIP-2 network, amount, asset, payTo, plus the bazaar discovery extension); the response body carries the same challenge in x402 v1 form for compatibility, naming the SOL recipient and USDC token account on Solana plus a fresh memo. To pay on this service's rail: pay with the memo attached (Solana Memo program), then retry with header 'X-Payment-Tx: <transaction signature>' and query parameter 'toll_memo=<memo>'.

To pay on this service's rail: pay with the memo attached (Solana Memo program), then retry with header 'X-Payment-Tx: <transaction signature>' and query parameter 'toll_memo=<memo>'.
